items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 5 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: You had 100.0% of your dinners at 8 pm or later, which is linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it goes.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 13.2 hours, with 66.7% of nights reaching 13 hours. In the program, adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared to coaching alone.
